run_flex_binary_moment: run flex_binary_moment to apply a binary function element-wise across two pandas Series or DataFrames
test_flex_binary_moment_pairwise: test flex_binary_moment with pairwise=True to compute pairwise binary operations between DataFrame columns
run_zsqrt: run zsqrt to compute the square root of a pandas Series or DataFrame, replacing negative values with zero
build_prep_binary: build prep_binary to align two pandas objects and mask out non-overlapping values for binary operations
review_flex_binary_moment_dataframe: review flex_binary_moment to apply a function between two DataFrames with aligned indices and unioned columns
